buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. ....................... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 3. Generic

OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 6. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NA Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: CGM/OFK OR HIS AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVE 7. This Single Tender Enquiry (on PAC basis) is being floated through GeM as Single bid for procurement of item “PACKAGES FOR 40MM L/70”. Offers of only M/s. Nammo LIAB AB, LINDESBERG and its authorized & approved vendor will b e accepted. 2. Financial turn over criteria: The bidders to submit turn over certificate/balanc e sheet/ITR duly certified by recognized chartered accountant for past 03 years as documentary evidence. MSE’s & Start-ups are exempted from financial turno ver criteria subject to subject to meeting of quality & technical specifications an d on submission of valid Udyam Registration Certificate/ Certificate of Recogniti on. 3. If any firm is found as debarred for subject item at any stage before placing o f supply order, Bid of the firm will not be considered for further evaluation. 4. Technical Documents shall be part of Tender & intimation and participation of PAC supplier or its authorised vendor in tender enquiry will be through email(of kpv4@ord.gov.in).

5. Inspection to be carried out as per inspection document i.e. QAP & Specificati on & Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent along with the Supply. The Materi al will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criter ia for acceptance of the Item. Place of Inspection & Authority:- At O. F. Khamaria, Raw Material/Bulk Quantity: CGM/(OF) KHAMARIA or its authorized representative. 6. Bidder has to submit the MII document/certificate mentioning the % of local c ontent of the material supplied. 7. Bidder has to submit Udyam Registration Certificate for availing Purchase pre ference clause of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs). 8. Compliance statement is enclosed herewith. Bidder has to submit this compli ance statement completely filled & duly signed with seal of the firm. 9. Pre-Qualification Criteria: Participation of only PAC Firm i.e. M/s. Nammo LIAB AB, LINDESBERG and authorised Vendor. 10. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (NDC On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: i. I M/s. ......... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provisi on, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. ii. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 11. Upon submission of the NDC, it shall be the sole responsibility of the bidder t o collect, thoroughly examine, and verify all drawings, component details (inclu ding spacers, sub-assemblies, and raw material specs), and quality plans well b efore the bid submission closing date. 12. A Model ECS Mandate Format is being uploaded with the Bid. The Bidders ar

e requested to submit this Mandate Format during tender finalization i.e. the fir m has to submit completely and correctly filled Mandate Format at the time of s upplying the material. 13. DP shall include supply of full order including all the inspection process invol ving raw material inspection, stage /final inspection before bulk supply as per Q AP & Specification. 14. EMD – not applicable 15. Performance Security deposit is to be submitted (in favour of Munitions Indi a Ltd., O F Khamaria) by the supplier as per TE terms & conditions if contract va lue (including all taxes) will be more than 5 Lakhs (within 30 days from the date of awarding of contract). Further it is advised that PSD may be submitted online through SB Collect portal (link- https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm . If seller submits the PSD through online payment mode, then seller shall upload the documentary proof of online payment of PSD at GeM Portal. Account Name: Munitions India Limited, O F Khamaria Account No. – 40436892598 (Current Account) IFSC – SBIN0003228 MICR -482002006 BANK ADDRESS –State Bank of India, Ranjhi (Jabalpur) 16. Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’s hired laborers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 22 0.00 / ton from the regular bills of firm. 17. Firm has to submit the pre-integrity pact duly signed and seal in a format up loaded with tender. 18. Submission of a commercial bid shall be treated as an absolute confirmation that the bidder has reviewed and fully understood the scope of work, technical d rawings, and specifications. Quoting an unviable/aggressive price solely to attain L-1 status and subsequently manufacturing excuses regarding missing documents or ambiguo us specifications will be treated as bad-faith bidding.

19. No technical queries, requests for clarification, or complaints regarding "mis sing drawings/specifications/spacers/plans" shall be entertained after order plac ement. All technical parameters shall be deemed clear and accepted by the bid der prior to quote submission. 20. No extension in the Delivery Period will be granted on grounds of alleged no n-availability or delayed receipt of technical documents. Any delay in supply on such pretexts shall be liable to strict action against the bidder. N.B. Eligible Bidders are requested to go through the attached QAP/Specificatio n and Tender Terms & Conditions and should satisfy themselves before particip ating in the tender. Any discrepancy should be intimated to the Buyer before op ening date. Firm has to submit the compliance with duly seal & sign against the compliance statement attached with the tender documents. . 8.
